fields.title: Local installation and free volume
fields.finding: Bed/housing volume is included but distribution stiffness, load introduction, detailed barrier solid volume and microlocal humidity are not resolved.
fields.proposed_fix: Integrate and test local mounts, thermal paths and humidity gradients; rerun structural/displacement accounting for final geometry.

claim: Bed/housing volume is included but distribution stiffness, load introduction, detailed barrier solid volume and microlocal humidity are not resolved. | Local installation and free volume
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
